summary: Engineering preview: native Instrument Teal HOME now cycles Core/Sound/Texture/Groove with HOME. Every bank shows its real control mapping; SELECT still browses progressions and PRESETS still changes chord sound. GLO > Display exposes K1 theme, K2 retained HOME view, and K4 Motion On/Off. Tap GLO again to open the selected Chord/Keyboard/Diagnostics view; HOME always returns to Core. Bank-label motion is clipped to the footer and Off settles it immediately. Source cover-chord intervals and slash bass notes are preserved in the native rail. Full Songs, remaining page migration, detailed pending setup and device verification are still pending.
